I am a dedicated educator who enjoys sharing knowledge and fostering an open and inclusive learning environment. Most of my teaching experience has been in the areas of data science, statistics, and network science. Committed to open science, I ensure all my educational contents are freely available online.

## Courses

- **PHS 7045: Advanced Programming with R and HPC** (University of Utah, Graduate Programs) ([link](https://github.com/UofUEpiBio/PHS7045-advanced-programming/tree/spring-2023){target="_blank"}): I co-design and teach this class with my colleague Dr. Jonathan Chipman to graduate students in the University of Utah Department of Population Health Sciences.

- **PM 566: Introduction to Health Data Science** (USC, Graduate Programs) ([link](https://github.com/USCbiostats/PM566/tree/fall2021){target="_blank"}): I co-designed this class with faculty from the USC's Division of Biostatistics as the introductory class to the USC Masters degree in Health Data Science.
